title.narrative: In 2025, in collaboration with the Ministry of Women and Children Affairs, UNICEF supported the expansion of an innovative social protection model. The pilot, which linked health and nutrition services with cash assistance to mothers and children, increased service uptake, enhanced government systems, and improved outcomes for children and women, successfully demonstrating scope for national scale-up.
